tips.text: Weave basic attacks between spells so Petricite Burst fires each time; its empowered hit gives bonus attack speed and magic damage.
Land Chain Lash on a target at the edge of range; the blast at the chains' crossing point hurts and the target is slowed.
Hold Kingslayer until you or the enemy champion is low on health; the heal is biggest when you are hurt.
Dash with Abscond, then recast as Abduct to pull yourself to the first enemy hit. It knocks them up, so follow with your other spells.
You cannot cast Chain Lash while the Abduct chains are in flight, so aim Abduct carefully before you throw it.
Use Hijack on an enemy champion whose ultimate fits the fight, then recast it for a free copy. You cannot steal from the same enemy again for a while.
Cast Chain Lash toward the enemy and let the chains cross on them. The explosion at the crossing point deals the bigger part of the damage.
Hold Kingslayer until you or the enemy is low on health. It heals you more the lower you are, and only when it hits a champion.
Cast Abscond first, then recast to Abduct within a short time. Abduct pulls you to the first enemy it hits and knocks them up.
Cast an ability, then basic attack right away. Petricite Burst gives bonus attack speed and extra magic damage from the charge.
Chain Lash slows enemies, so use it to stop them walking away. Follow with Kingslayer to finish them off.
Use Hijack on a dangerous enemy ultimate and save it for the right fight. You can hold it for a while before you cast it.
Do not throw Abduct into minions. The chains stop at the first enemy hit, and you cannot cast Chain Lash while they are flying.

combos.name: Abscond-Kingslayer dash
combos.when: When you need to close distance or surprise a target in a trade.
combos.text: The wiki notes Kingslayer can be cast during Abscond's dash. Use it to close in and heal before the Abduct recast.

combos.name: Abduct into Kingslayer
combos.when: When you want to catch a target and burst them while using the passive.
combos.text: Dash with the first cast, then recast to pull in and knock up. Follow with Kingslayer and an empowered attack, since each cast gives an attack-speed charge.

tips.text: Aim Abduct at Aatrox from a distance, then Kingslayer to finish. The chains' stun gives you time to follow up.
Step out of The Darkin Blade's hit zones; the swings are slow and easy to read. Avoid the outer edge, which knocks you up.
Leave Infernal Chains by running to the sides or toward Aatrox, or you get pulled back and hit again.
Hold Hijack when Aatrox uses World Ender; it can't be stolen cheaply, so step back and don't let him get a takedown.
Save Abduct for when Ambessa commits to a dash or sweep; it stuns her and pulls you in, but a minion in the way blocks the chains.
Use Chain Lash from long range. Ambessa has to close the gap, and the slow makes her approach harder.
Fight her after she has spent her abilities. Kingslayer heals you most when you are low, so lunge in for the heal once the trade is close.
Steal Public Execution only when you can use it right away. Ambessa can still dash and sweep around it.
Dodge the Bandage Toss; sidestep it or keep a minion between you and Amumu so he cannot reach you.
Stay away from your team when Amumu's ultimate is ready, so he cannot stun you along with everyone else.
Use Hijack on Curse of the Sad Mummy in a fight to get your own big stun, and Amumu cannot copy anything back.
Do not stay on Amumu for long; Despair and Tantrum add up and he is tanky. Kingslayer him only when you are hurt and it heals you well.
Aim Abduct at Bel'Veth when she is out of dashes; the stun and knock up stop her from fighting back.
Chain Lash her as she approaches; the slow makes her harder to chase with.
Do not fight her long once she builds attack speed; spread your abilities out so Petricite Burst triggers often.
Hold Kingslayer until you are hurt, then use it on her to heal back up.
Stay away from her Above and Below; it knocks you up and slows you.
Sidestep Sear and Pillar of Flame. Brand needs one of them to land before his combo can start.
Use Abduct to catch Brand and pull yourself onto him. Up close he has little escape from your Kingslayer.
Hijack Brand's Pyroclasm in a fight. It does not apply Blaze, but it still bounces and hits hard.
Fight Brand away from your teammates. He deals the most damage when enemies are clustered, so stay apart from your allies.
Use Kingslayer when you are low on health to heal back up after Brand's burn.
Keep Chain Lash and Abduct ready for Briar's dive. Abduct stuns her, which stops her Head Rush follow-up.
Briar is forced to chase the nearest enemy during Blood Frenzy. Pull back, slow her with Chain Lash and trade.
Briar heals from her bleeds, so use Kingslayer to burst her down and finish her before she heals back.
Hijack Certain Death for yourself and use it on Briar's team, or on Briar once she has used it.
Stay out of Darius's reach and keep Chain Lash going from range; he wants a long close fight.
Hold Abscond and Abduct for when Darius uses Apprehend, then hit him to stun him and get away.
Use Kingslayer once you are low on health; it heals you more then. Do it after Darius has spent his slow.
Hijack Noxian Guillotine to execute a weakened enemy, though Darius's Hemorrhage stacks won't add damage to your copy.
Walk out of the Moonlight on you before Diana can dash in. Lunar Rush refreshes when it hits a marked target.
Aim Abduct at Diana when she dashes in. It stuns her, which stops her from following up.
Do not fight Diana while her Pale Cascade shield is up. Wait for it to fade, then trade.
Chain Lash leaves Diana slowed. Use it when she dashes in with no way back out.
Steal Moonfall with Hijack when you can. Diana's own ultimate pulls her group in and can win you a fight.
Do not rely on Abduct to start a fight with Mundo; his passive resists the first stun, so look for a different opening.
Step on the dropped canister to destroy it. This denies Mundo his heal and a quicker passive.
Dodge Infected Bonesaw; it is a thin line shot and slows you. Chain Lash lets you poke him from a distance.
Do not sit in Heart Zapper while he stores your damage. Back off or wait for the detonation.
Mundo heals through damage after Maximum Dosage, so burst him fast or leave the fight.
Look for Ekko's afterimage trail. When Chronobreak is down, you can trade and chase him much more safely.
Abduct needs to hit Ekko to pull you in. Aim it where he will be, and don't throw it when you can't escape his follow-up.
Don't stand in the Parallel Convergence field once it is armed. Walk out of it before Ekko can step in and stun you.
Use Kingslayer when you are hurt for the biggest heal, but only when Ekko can't easily punish the dash.
Use Hijack on Ekko only when you can make good use of Chronobreak. It lets you copy his escape and his damage.
Watch for the arrow that shows Evelynn marked you with Allure. Stay near allies and keep minions between you and her.
Hold Abduct for Evelynn when she shows herself; it stuns her and knocks her up, which can break her ambush.
Hijack Evelynn's ultimate only when you can use it well; Last Caress makes her untargetable and hits hard against low-health targets.
Do not trust Fiddlesticks's scarecrows or still bushes. If the enemy is hidden, expect a fear.
Save Abscond to dash out of Reap's silence. If you are silenced you cannot use it.
Hijack Crowstorm when you can to use it on Fiddlesticks. Cast it from a distance so he cannot easily answer.
Use Kingslayer to trade with Fiddlesticks when you are low, because the heal is stronger the lower your health is.
Do not chase Graves into Smoke Screen. It slows you and cuts your vision, so wait for it to fade or step out.
Use Kingslayer when you are hurt in a fight with Graves. It heals you more the lower your health is.
Graves' Quickdraw is his escape and defence. Try to fight when it is on cooldown, because he gets tougher with each use.
Chain Lash then Abduct is a good combo against Graves. Use Abduct to pull in and knock him up before he can reload and shoot.
Hijack Collateral Damage once Graves uses it. It makes a strong ultimate to use against him once his own is on cooldown.
Aim Abduct at Gwen before she can cast Hallowed Mist; chains thrown at her from outside the mist are destroyed.
Wait out Hallowed Mist, or fight her from inside it. Outside the mist you can't target her, so you waste abilities.
Use Kingslayer when Gwen is low or you are. It heals you more the lower your own health is.
Gwen needs a few attacks to set up her damage, so open the fight with Chain Lash and Abduct before she has built up.
Hijack Needlework only if she has no mist to block it; it's a good steal for a long fight.
Keep Kingslayer for when Hecarim is close and you are hurt; it heals you more the lower your health is.
Hit Hecarim with Chain Lash as he charges in; it slows him and breaks the run-up that powers Devastating Charge.
Hecarim is fastest when Devastating Charge has been running a while. Use Abscond to dodge the hit, then Abduct to pull yourself onto him.
Hijack can steal Onslaught of Shadows from Hecarim. Use it to start a fight or to escape.
Stay away from Hecarim while Spirit of Dread is up; he heals from the damage you take, so wait for it to end.
Hold Abscond until Ivern uses Rootcaller, then dash away to dodge it before you commit with Abduct.
Steal Ivern's Daisy! with Hijack when you can; it gives you a knock up for a fight.
Wait for Triggerseed to burst before you jump in; the shield and slow make the dive harder.
Chain Lash from a distance to hit Ivern when he steps out of brush; he is slippery, so do not chase far.
Use Kingslayer once you are low to heal back up, especially if Ivern has no Rootcaller ready to stop you.
Stay out of the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard. Dragon Strike through it knocks you up.
Wait until Jarvan has used Cataclysm, then trade into him. His fighting power drops while it is on cooldown.
Hijack Cataclysm in a fight to trap Jarvan's team, but be careful. You can't steal from him again for a while.
Use Kingslayer when you are low and Jarvan is in range. The healing is at its best when you are hurt.
Aim Abduct at Jax from a distance; he is stunned if hit and you get pulled in.
Wait for Jax's Counter Strike to end before you go in; he dodges your attacks while it lasts.
Use Chain Lash from range to keep Jax slowed and stop him from closing on you.
Hijack can steal Grandmaster-at-Arms; the stolen version adds magic damage to your attacks, so use it in a fight.
Use Kingslayer when you are low on health to heal back up.
Dash onto Jayce with Kingslayer when he is in Cannon Stance; he is weak up close and you heal from the hit.
Stay out of a straight line with Jayce and step aside from his Shock Blast, which stops at the first enemy it hits.
If Jayce places an Acceleration Gate, expect a fast, long-range Shock Blast and stay out of its line.
Hit Jayce with Abduct to get him stunned, then follow with a basic attack from Petricite Burst.
Jayce is strong early, so play safe until you have your own advantage.
Hold Kingslayer until you are hurt or Karthus is low. You heal the most when you are low on health.
Hijack Requiem when you can. Karthus is fragile and the stolen ultimate hits hard.
Land Abduct on Karthus and burst him. He has no dash to escape and is easy to catch.
Do not walk through Wall of Pain. It slows you and lowers your Magic Resist.
Move away from Karthus's corpse after you kill him. Death Defied lets him keep casting for a few seconds.
Keep your health up so you survive Requiem. Back off before the channel finishes.
Hit Kayn with Abduct when he is in terrain or about to dash; the stun and knock up end his Shadow Step.
Stay away from Kayn when he has hit you with Blade's Reach; he can then jump onto you with Umbral Trespass.
Steal Umbral Trespass with Hijack once Kayn uses it, or hold Hijack until he is ready to dive.
Trade when you are low with Kingslayer to heal back up; a Kayn without his abilities cannot punish you.
Watch for the warning on terrain edges; Kayn may be coming through the wall at you.
Wait for Kha'Zix to leap before you cast Abscond / Abduct, then use Abduct to pull him onto you and make him stand and fight.
Stay near your minions or allies so Kha'Zix cannot make you isolated and hit you with a huge Taste Their Fear.
Chain Lash slows Kha'Zix when you hit him as he comes in; follow with Kingslayer to punish him.
Kha'Zix is weak while Leap and Void Assault are on cooldown, so look to fight him then.
Hijack can steal Void Assault, so use it on Kha'Zix when you need an escape or an ambush.
Aim Abduct at Kindred when she steps up to fight. It stuns her, and Sylas then pulls in and knocks her up.
Break off when Kindred has you marked with Mounting Dread; her third attack on you brings Wolf in for a big hit.
Don't commit to a fight inside Lamb's Respite. Nobody dies in it, so wait for it to end before you go in.
Use Kingslayer to heal when you are low in a fight with Kindred, then retreat. Kindred is fragile, so press her.
Hijack her ultimate when you can; Lamb's Respite lets you save an ally or trap a fight.
Hit Lee Sin with Abduct when he dashes in or lands. It stuns and knocks him up, and you can then punish him.
Use Chain Lash to slow Lee Sin when he rushes in. Lee Sin is weak to magic damage, so keep trading with your spells.
Wait until Lee Sin is low before using Kingslayer, or until you are, so the heal is large.
Steal Lee Sin's Dragon's Rage with Hijack when you can. It gives you a strong kick, and he cannot be hijacked again for a while.
Space out your spells so you keep Petricite Burst stacks for strong basic attacks while Lee Sin is close.
Hold Hijack until Lillia has used Lilting Lullaby on you or your team; stealing it gives you a sleep of your own, but she needs Dream Dust on you to cast hers.
Hit Lillia with Abduct when she is out of position; she is stunned and you are pulled to her, so you can finish with Kingslayer.
Save Kingslayer for when you are hurt; the heal is biggest at low health, which helps in a long fight against her draining Dream Dust.
Hit Lillia with Chain Lash from range; she is slowed, and her fast dash-ins are easier to answer.
Hold Abduct for Master Yi's approach; it stuns him and knocks him up, which stops Alpha Strike from being used.
Chain Lash slows Master Yi, so use it before he activates Highlander, which makes him immune to slows.
Do not use Kingslayer on Master Yi while he is in Alpha Strike; he cannot be targeted then, so wait until he reappears.
Hijack Highlander when Master Yi is not using it; the speed and attack speed work well for your own chase or escape.
Keep your distance and poke him, and force him to waste mana on Meditate to heal.
Do not trust Wukong's first target; after Nimbus Strike he often swaps with a clone from Warrior Trickster, so wait a moment before using Abduct.
Use Kingslayer when you are low to heal back up, but avoid long fights; Wukong gets tankier as he lands hits.
Chain Lash slows Wukong, so use it to catch him when he tries to leave or to open a short trade.
Stay out of Cyclone's range at level 6; if you can, hijack it for yourself and use it back on him.
Use Abscond / Abduct on Naafiri when she's away from her packmates; the chains stop at the first enemy hit, so a packmate in front can block them.
Hold Kingslayer until Naafiri is low or you are; the heal is strongest when you are hurt, and it only heals when the target is a champion.
Use Chain Lash on Naafiri when she dashes in or backs off, because it slows her. Aim for where the chains cross so the blast lands.
Hijack Hounds' Pursuit when you can; it has a long channel, so use it to chase a fleeing target or dive in with a shield on the recast.
Weave basic attacks between spells so Petricite Burst hits often. It also kills small packmates around her.
Close the distance on Nidalee with Abscond, then Abduct. Her javelin is weakest up close, and the Abduct stun stops her escaping.
Dodge Javelin Toss when she is far away. A hit marks you as Hunted and sets up her Pounce and Takedown.
Use Kingslayer when your health is low to heal during a fight. Nidalee's burst can bring you low quickly.
Chain Lash slows her, so use it when she goes into cougar form and leaps at you.
Check brush before you walk in. Her Bushwhack traps are invisible and deal damage over time.
Fight Nocturne when Shroud of Darkness is on cooldown; otherwise he blocks your Abduct and gets faster attacks.
Use Abscond to get out of range when Nocturne starts Unspeakable Horror, so the tether breaks before the fear.
Hijack Nocturne's Paranoia when you can; it hurts his ultimate and gives you a dash onto an enemy.
Stay near your team when Paranoia goes off; Nocturne's dash cannot be stopped by crowd control.
Use Kingslayer after trading so you heal while Nocturne is hurt.
Steal Absolute Zero with Hijack once Nunu has used it, or when it can catch several enemies, but note it works on a long cooldown.
Use Abduct to stop Nunu rolling a snowball. Chains hit the first enemy in their path, and the stun lets you pull yourself in.
Keep your distance when Nunu has Consume ready in a long fight, because it heals him. Trade with Chain Lash when he is not near.
Do not fight Nunu's Snowball Barrage rooting you. Step away from Willump before it goes off after a few seconds.
Hit Pantheon with Abduct when he is walking up; it stuns him and pulls you in before he can jump.
Don't chase Pantheon into Aegis Assault from the front; go around him or wait for it to end.
Keep your health up against Pantheon; his hurled Comet Spear hurts you much more when you are low.
Hijack can steal Grand Starfall after Pantheon uses it, so look for a chance to take it when you want to use it.
Land Abduct on Qiyana when she has used Audacity; she is easy to catch while that is on cooldown.
Fight away from walls and brush when you can; Supreme Display of Talent stuns you when it blasts the terrain.
Try to steal Supreme Display of Talent with Hijack when you are near a wall. It is a strong stun for you.
Qiyana with Ice can root you with Elemental Wrath, so stay out of its line.
Use Kingslayer once you are hurt in a fight; the heal is biggest when you are low.
Don't fight Rammus while Defensive Ball Curl is up; it returns damage to you. Wait until it ends, then trade.
Keep your distance from Rammus with Chain Lash, and don't let him reach you with Frenzying Taunt, since you can't act while taunted.
Hijack Rammus's Soaring Slam only when it is safe. It is a strong tool for chasing or escaping.
Don't Hijack Rek'Sai's Void Rush casually. Wait until she has marked you or an ally, since it needs a marked target.
Aim Abduct at Rek'Sai when she is Unburrowed. It stuns her and knocks her up, which stops her from biting you.
Stay away from Rek'Sai when her Fury is full, because Furious Bite then deals true damage.
Move carefully while she is burrowed nearby. Her Burrow shows your position only while you are moving.
Keep Abduct ready when Rengar is near; pulling yourself to a target or dashing away can save you from a leap.
Stay away from brush; Rengar leaps out of it with Unseen Predator.
Fight Rengar when his Ferocity is low; his empowered Bola Strike roots, while the unempowered one only slows.
Use Chain Lash on Rengar when he closes in; it slows him and its explosion punishes him for staying.
Watch for the mark over your head when Rengar uses Thrill of the Hunt; he is coming for you.
Pick fights when Sejuani has used Arctic Assault. Without it she has a hard time getting on you.
Sejuani's Frost Armor makes her tanky and immune to slows, so Chain Lash will not slow her. Trade when she has just taken damage and lost it.
Steal Glacial Prison with Hijack when it is ready. Using it against her team is a strong fight opener.
Avoid being near Sejuani's melee allies with no escape ready; once Permafrost has stacks on you, you get stunned.
Stay away from bushes and choke points where Shaco may have hidden a Jack In The Box. Ward them, since the trap is invisible.
Hold Abscond and Abduct for when Shaco appears from Deceive. Abduct stuns and knocks him up, which stops his attack.
Chain Lash slows Shaco and its blast hurts; use it when he reveals himself to stop him from chasing you.
Hijack Shaco's Hallucinate to get your own clone. You can use it to scare off his gank.
Use Kingslayer to heal when Shaco leaves you low, but only if no trap is near. Otherwise you will lunge into one.
Keep your distance from Shyvana and poke with Chain Lash; she gets her power from hitting you.
Land Abduct on Shyvana only when you can get away; she hits hard once she is on you, so use Abscond to back out.
Wait until her Inferno Aegis shield has run out before you commit; it soaks your burst and speeds her up.
Take Kingslayer into a fight once you or she are low; the heal is biggest then.
Try to hit Shyvana when she is low on Fury, so she cannot turn dragon.
Hijack Shyvana's Dragon's Descent when you have it available; you get a dragon form of your own.
Hit Skarner with Abduct when he charges in. It stuns him and ends his charge.
Stay away from walls when Skarner is charging at you. A wall hit stuns you.
Use Kingslayer when your health is low to heal the most. Do it before Skarner's Quaking builds up.
Don't Hijack Impale out of habit. Skarner's Impale is easy to dodge, so keep your own steady poke going.
Steal Talon's Shadow Assault with Hijack to escape or burst. Cast it only once he has used his own ultimate.
Talon is slowed after Rake returns to him. Catch him with Abduct when he has no jump available.
Talon's damage is all physical and comes in a quick burst. Do not give him free Wound stacks; step out of his spells.
Use Kingslayer once Talon has used his burst and you are hurt, so the healing is at its strongest.
Space your spells so Petricite Burst gives you a boosted attack when Talon jumps in with Noxian Diplomacy.
Do not fight Trundle on his Frozen Domain. Wait until he leaves it, or his speed and attacks will beat you.
Save Kingslayer for when you are hurt or Trundle is low. It heals you most when your health is low.
Step out of Pillar of Ice quickly, since it slows you. Do not fight next to it.
Use Chain Lash to poke Trundle from range before he gets his Chomp on you.
Hijack can steal Subjugate. Cast it on Trundle when you are ready to fight, and he cannot be hijacked again for a while.
Keep your distance from Udyr and poke with Chain Lash. He has few ranged options.
Hold Abscond ready for when Udyr runs at you. Its chains can pull you onto him, but you must aim them yourself.
Wait until you are hurt or Udyr is low before using Kingslayer; the heal is biggest when your health is low.
Do not trade inside Udyr's storm. He damages and slows you there, so fight on your terms and back out.
Aim Abduct at Vi when she is alone in the jungle; the stun lets you pull yourself to her and start a fight.
Don't fight while Vi is charging Vault Breaker; step aside, because a full charge does much more damage.
Use Chain Lash to slow Vi as she tries to close in, and keep your distance.
Stay out of long brawls. After three hits Vi shreds your Armor and attacks faster, so back off before the third hit.
Take Vi's ultimate with Hijack only when it is safe. Her Cease and Desist can't be stopped once it starts.
Use Kingslayer when you are low on health; it heals you most then. Save it for Viego as he dives in.
Hit Viego with Chain Lash when he charges Spectral Maw; he moves slower while charging.
Aim Abduct at Viego when he comes out of the mist; it stuns him and pulls you in.
Steal Heartbreaker with Hijack when you can, and use it on a fighter who is low on health.
Land Abduct on Volibear from range. It stuns him and pulls you in, and a stun before his Thundering Smash hits cancels it.
Save Kingslayer until you are hurt or he is low; the heal is biggest at low Health.
Poke him with Chain Lash before he reaches you. He is tanky and wins long close fights.
Do not fight in his Stormbringer window; he is far sturdier and hits from farther away. Steal it with Hijack if you can.
Don't trade at low health with Warwick; his Eternal Hunger heals him a lot when he is hurt, so finish fights fast.
Hit Warwick with Abduct to stun him before he reaches you; keep your distance otherwise.
Keep your health up. Warwick hunts hurt enemies with Blood Hunt, so Kingslayer is best used to heal when he commits.
Take Infinite Duress with Hijack when you can; Warwick leaps a long way, so stay away from him in the open.
Hit Xin Zhao with Abduct when he runs at you; it stuns him and pulls you in to knock him up.
Use Kingslayer once you are low or he is low; the heal grows with your missing health.
Stay away from Xin Zhao's Three Talon Strike hits; the third knocks you up and he refreshes his other cooldowns with each hit.
Do not stand close to Xin Zhao when his Crescent Guard is ready; it knocks you back unless you are Challenged.
Poke with Chain Lash from range; the slow helps you walk away from his charge.
Hit Zac with Abduct while he charges Elastic Slingshot; stuns and knock ups interrupt the charge.
Step on Zac's goo to destroy it so he cannot heal from it, especially after he trades with you.
When Zac splits into bloblets, kill them all to stop him coming back.
Hijack Zac's Let's Bounce! at level 6 for a strong engage or a quick escape.
Use Chain Lash from range to leave Zac slowed as he closes in, and keep your distance from Stretching Strikes.
Hold Abscond / Abduct for when Zed commits. Landing it stuns him and pulls you onto him.
Zed is weakest right after he spends Living Shadow, so jump on him then with Kingslayer.
Zed's Death Mark detonates after a short delay. Fight back and heal with Kingslayer while it counts down.
Hijack can steal Death Mark. Save it for a moment when Zed is not able to respond.
Dodge Grasping Roots before you commit; being rooted stops your dashes and leaves you open to plants.
Step on Zyra's seeds to destroy them before she can grow plants from them.
Use Abduct to pull yourself onto Zyra; she is fragile, and Kingslayer then heals you.
Steal Stranglethorns with Hijack and cast it onto Zyra's team once her ultimate is used or on cooldown.
Fight away from her seeds; her plants are weak when she has few seeds around.
Use Abduct when Ahri has used Charm. You can pull to her and trade safely.
Stay behind minions so Charm hits them first and ends there.
Save Kingslayer until you or Ahri are low; the heal is biggest when you are hurt.
At level 6, use Hijack on Ahri's Spirit Rush to chase or escape. She cannot be stolen from again for a while.
Chain Lash slows Ahri, so use it to cut down her ability to kite you.
Wait until Akali is low on energy before you trade. Her Five Point Strike is weak without it.
Hit the Twilight Shroud with Abduct or Chain Lash when she hides; area spells briefly reveal her.
Use Hijack on Perfect Execution when she dives you, and save yours for when she has used it.
Use Kingslayer to heal once you are hurt, and to close in on her when she tries to flee.
Aim Abduct at Akshan when he has no escape up. It stuns him, and you get pulled in to knock him up.
Use Chain Lash to slow Akshan as he steps up to trade. Step out of the delayed blast, because it does the most damage.
Save Kingslayer for when you are hurt. It heals more the lower your health, which wins you a trade against Akshan.
Be careful when Akshan is hidden in brush or beside walls with Going Rogue. He can pop out and attack you from stealth.
Do not hijack Comeuppance while Akshan is not channeling. Stealing it from him is not worth it.
Dodge Flash Frost by staying out of its line. Getting hit leaves you slowed and open to a strong Frostbite.
Use Abduct to pull yourself onto Anivia when her Flash Frost is on cooldown; she is fragile and hurts less up close.
Anivia's egg returns her to full health, so kill her twice or save your damage for after Rebirth.
Hijack Anivia's ultimate only if it's a good fit; the enemy can't be hijacked again for a while after.
Use Kingslayer to close in on Anivia once she has spent her spells, healing yourself as you hit her.
Watch Annie's Pyromania counter. When it is full, her next spell stuns you, so do not walk into her range.
Hit Annie with Chain Lash when she steps up to last-hit; it slows her and the chains explode where they cross.
Hijack her Summon: Tibbers when you can. You get a strong ultimate of your own, and she cannot be hijacked again for a while.
Use Abduct to close the gap to Annie, then trade with Kingslayer and your empowered attack. Leave once she has a stun ready.
Back off from Tibbers after Annie summons him; he burns anyone nearby.
Step out of the black hole right away, because Singularity keeps dragging you toward the center. Do not stand in it.
Hit Aurelion Sol with Abduct when he is mid-cast. It stuns him and pulls you onto him.
Be wary of Hijack on Aurelion Sol's ultimate once he has built Stardust. It turns into a big knock up and slow.
Trade with Chain Lash while he is channeling Breath of Light, since he is slow to react. Stay out of the beam's reach.
Throw Abduct at Aurora when she has used Across the Veil; the hop is short and you can chase her down after the knock up.
Use Kingslayer when your health is low and Aurora is in reach; the heal on a champion hit turns the trade around.
Chain Lash from long range to slow Aurora, then weave in a basic attack so Petricite Burst adds damage.
Hijack Between Worlds at level 6 when you can; it gives you an escape and a big slowing blast of your own.
Hit Azir with Abduct when he has used Shifting Sands. He can't dodge it, and you can burst him before his soldiers do damage.
Stay out of his soldiers' stabs; he has no big burst, but damage builds up over a long fight.
Hijack Emperor's Divide to use it yourself, and save it for when Azir has no wall to answer with.
Wait until Azir has no soldiers placed, then dash in with Kingslayer and trade. His damage mostly comes from the soldiers.
Walk to the side of Sear to dodge it. Brand needs a hit to start his combo, so dodging it ruins his trade.
Sidestep Pillar of Flame, since it lands after a short delay. Move out of the circle as soon as you see it.
Engage with Abduct when Brand's Sear is on cooldown. Brand has no escape, so you can then trade freely and heal with Kingslayer.
Stay away from your minions when Brand is near. Conflagration spreads to enemies around its target, so don't stand beside them.
Steal Pyroclasm with Hijack once Brand is in range, and use it on him in a fight.
Aim Abduct at Briar as she jumps in, because her Blood Frenzy locks her onto one target. Hold your Abscond for the recast.
Don't fight Briar when she is low; Crimson Curse and Snack Attack heal her a lot, so a Kingslayer on her won't finish the job.
Stand away from walls when Briar charges Chilling Scream; if it knocks you into one you take big damage and are stunned.
Hijack Certain Death from Briar once you reach level 6 and use it on her. It also fears her allies.
Don't use Abscond to dash into Miasma; it leaves you grounded and slowed. Cassiopeia then hits you with Twin Fang and Noxious Blast.
Hit Cassiopeia with Abduct to stun and pull yourself onto her. Then follow with Kingslayer and Chain Lash.
Never walk at Cassiopeia head-on while Petrifying Gaze is ready. Approach from the side or turn away to be slowed instead of stunned.
Steal Petrifying Gaze with Hijack and use it on Cassiopeia when she is facing you. Her stun then works against her.
Dodge Noxious Blast by moving after it lands; it explodes after a short delay. Taking less poison means weaker Twin Fang hits.
Aim Abduct at Diana when she dashes in; stunning her with it leaves her no way to escape.
Dodge Crescent Strike; once you are marked with Moonlight, Diana can dash to you with Lunar Rush again and again.
Wait for her Pale Cascade shield to run out before you trade. Hit her with Chain Lash afterward.
Use Kingslayer once the fight has dropped you low; it heals more the lower your health is.
Hijack can steal Moonfall at level 6; if you steal it before she uses it, she has less to fight with.
Hit Ekko with Abduct when he is out of position. It stuns him and pulls you in.
Watch for Ekko's trail to see if Chronobreak is ready. Fight harder when it is down.
Use Kingslayer once you or Ekko are low, so the heal is bigger.
Step away from the Parallel Convergence circle after it appears. Ekko must walk into it to stun you.
Hijack Ekko's Chronobreak and use it to rewind your own position in a fight.
Open with Abduct when Ezreal has no minion in the line. Land it and you can trade hard before he escapes.
Bait out Arcane Shift before you commit. Once it is on cooldown, Ezreal has little way to get out of your reach.
Use Kingslayer to close the gap and heal in a trade. It heals the most when you are low, so use it when you are hurt.
Ezreal is fragile, so take the fight to him. Walk up and catch him once his Mystic Shot is on cooldown.
Steal Trueshot Barrage with Hijack and use it on Ezreal or his team when they bunch up.
Stand behind minions when Ezreal is in range, since Mystic Shot hits only the first enemy in its path.
Keep Kingslayer for when Fizz commits to a fight; the heal is biggest when you are low.
Hold Abduct until Playful ends; Fizz cannot be hit while untargetable, so a chain thrown early is wasted.
Stay out of Fizz's reach after he uses Seastone Trident; his attacks hit harder for a few seconds.
Hijack Chum the Waters once Fizz uses it, then use it on him; wait until his ultimate is down to fight him freely.
Don't trade into a charged Shield of Durand; wait for Galio to release it, then go in.
Galio is slowed while charging Shield of Durand, so hit him with Chain Lash then.
Galio cannot cross walls with Justice Punch, so stand with terrain behind you and he cannot easily reach you.
Hijack Hero's Entrance to shield your team in a fight, or save it for a better ultimate.
Space out your casts to get the most from Petricite Burst; poke Galio with Chain Lash from range.
Close in with Abscond, then recast Abduct to pull yourself onto Hwei; he has little to stop you once you are on him.
Rush Hwei right after he paints a Torment spell. He is easy to catch then.
Use Kingslayer when Hwei or you are low on health; the heal is strongest then.
Space out your spells so Petricite Burst gives you a basic attack between them in a trade.
Sidestep the slow lightning bolt. It hurts most when you are alone or can't move, so stay near minions and keep moving.
Wait until Irelia has no minions near her to dash to. Without them she has a hard time reaching you.
Don't spend Abduct while Irelia is charging Defiant Dance. She takes less damage and can't be interrupted.
Hijack her Vanguard's Edge at level 6. Your copy also marks enemies as Unsteady for Bladesurge.
Use Chain Lash to poke Irelia when she walks up to last-hit. It slows her.
Do not Hijack Kassadin's Riftwalk; it only gives one use, so steal from someone else.
Kassadin takes reduced magic damage, so weave basic attacks between spells with Petricite Burst rather than relying on spells alone.
Fight Kassadin early, before level 6, when he has no Riftwalk to escape or close the gap.
Aim Abduct carefully; Null Sphere can interrupt and shield him, and Force Pulse leaves you slowed if you walk into it.
Hit Katarina with Abduct when she lands from Shunpo; being knocked up stops her from channeling Death Lotus.
Steal Death Lotus with Hijack once she has used it, or fight her while it is on cooldown. Katarina is weakest when her Shunpo is down.
Use Chain Lash on Katarina as she walks in to grab daggers; the slow makes her easier to hit and keeps her away from them.
Trade with Kingslayer when Katarina has no daggers up; it heals you more the lower you are.
Stay away from LeBlanc's Sigil of Malice and Distortion before level 6. Trade with Chain Lash when she steps up to farm.
Use Abscond to get near LeBlanc, then Abduct her. She may return with Distortion, so keep Kingslayer ready to chase.
Wait for LeBlanc to use Distortion, then fight her before she can return. Her Mirror Image can trick you at low health.
Use Hijack on LeBlanc at level 6 to take Mimic.
Use Kingslayer in fights with LeBlanc once you are low on health, because the heal gets stronger as your health drops.
Stay out of Ring of Frost range when it is ready; being rooted next to Lissandra lets her land the rest of her combo.
Trade when Ring of Frost is on cooldown; its cooldown is long early on.
Stay behind your minions so Ice Shard hits them first and only they get slowed.
Use Abduct to stun Lissandra before she recasts Glacial Path, to stop her escape.
Once Lissandra uses Frozen Tomb, Hijack can steal it. Use it to finish her or escape, but not while she can still react.
Dodge Light Binding by stepping sideways or behind a minion. It roots only the first two enemies, so minions in front absorb it.
Hijack Lux's Final Spark when you can; it does not apply her Illumination mark, and it hits hard from far away.
Wait until Light Binding is on cooldown, then go in with Abscond and Abduct. Lux has few ways to stop you.
Use Kingslayer when Lux's shield is gone and you are hurt; it heals you more the lower your health.
Don't stand in Lucent Singularity; it leaves you slowed and then hits you when it bursts.
Bait out Malzahar's Call of the Void before you dive in; if you are silenced you cannot use Abduct or Kingslayer.
Hit Malzahar with Chain Lash to break Void Shift, then follow up with your other spells while he has no protection.
Stay away from minions carrying Malefic Visions; when they die it jumps to you.
Do not hijack Nether Grasp early in a fight just to steal it; Malzahar's ultimate is best used on him when he has no chance to react.
Walk up and fight right after Mel spends Rebuttal; her projectile shield is down for a long while, so Abduct and Chain Lash land freely.
Do not throw Abduct or Chain Lash into Rebuttal's nova, because it destroys enemy projectiles and sends damage back at you.
Kingslayer is a targeted dash, not a projectile, so Rebuttal cannot destroy it. Use it to close in on Mel and heal when you are hurt.
Stay out of a straight line from Mel. Solar Snare roots you, and she follows it with her other spells.
Do not trade for long, because every hit adds Overwhelm and once you are low her next hit executes you. Back off until the stacks fade.
Hijack her Golden Eclipse once she has hit you or your team; it only works on enemies with Overwhelm on them. Use it to finish a low target.
Use Abscond then Abduct to stun and pull yourself onto Naafiri when she steps up; the knock up gives you time to follow with Kingslayer.
Hit Naafiri with Chain Lash as she closes in; she is slowed and takes a second hit when the chains' intersection explodes.
Wait for Naafiri to spend Eviscerate before you walk into her; it is her escape and it heals her packmates.
Do not try to Kingslayer her while she is untargetable from The Call of the Pack; it will have no effect.
Hijack her Hounds' Pursuit only if you want that dash; it is a single-target ultimate you can cast later on whoever you choose.
Close the gap with Abscond, then use Abduct on Orianna to stun and knock her up. She has little to stop you.
Step out of the path of Command: Attack. It is a slow missile you can dodge, and it hurts when it lands.
Watch where the Ball sits. Orianna's spells only hit near it, so fight away from it.
Steal Command: Shockwave with Hijack once you hit level 6. You can use it on her without a Ball.
Use Kingslayer on Orianna when you are hurt, to heal back while you trade.
Space your spells apart so Petricite Burst gives you empowered attacks in the trade. Chain Lash then a quick attack hits hard.
Use Chain Lash on Qiyana when she dashes in with Audacity. The slow and the delayed blast punish her for committing.
Keep Abscond ready so you can recast it into Abduct. It can stun her if she lands next to you and is not paying attention.
Hijack Qiyana's ultimate when she is not near it, then use it against her near a wall. Her shockwave stuns, so use it with care.
Do not stand in rivers or brush when Qiyana has her ultimate. Her shockwave cascades through them and stuns you.
Use Kingslayer to heal when you are low and she has spent her dashes.
Dodge Spell Flux's mark when you can; Flux makes Overload hit harder and turns Rune Prison into a root.
Land Abscond / Abduct on Ryze when his Rune Prison is on cooldown. He has few ways out once you are on him.
Use Kingslayer to close the gap and heal when you are hurt. Ryze has no quick way to push you off.
Use Chain Lash from range to slow Ryze and poke him, since he wants to trade spells with you.
Stun or knock up Ryze while his Realm Warp is charging; it cancels his portal.
Hit Syndra with Abduct when she has no Scatter the Weak ready; then you can chain a fight on her.
Do not dash in while she has Scatter the Weak and a Dark Sphere nearby; you can be knocked back and stunned.
Use Kingslayer to heal in trades once you are hurt; it works best when your health is low.
Steal Unleashed Power with Hijack when it is available, and use it on her; you can kill her with her own spheres.
Chain Lash slows her, so follow it with a quick attack or Abduct while she is slowed.
Dodge Threaded Volley by stepping sideways; the rocks fly in a fixed direction.
Watch for Seismic Shove after Taliyah lays Unraveled Earth. Don't stand where she can throw you into the stones.
Don't dash with Abscond or Kingslayer over her stones; you will be stunned when you land.
Take your trades with Kingslayer when your health is low, since the heal is strongest then.
Hijack Weaver's Wall at level 6 to cut off her escape.
Don't stand at the edge of Rake's range. Its blades slow you on the return, so back away and avoid the second pass.
Hold Kingslayer until Talon commits his burst, or until you are low. It heals you most when you are hurt.
Aim Abduct at Talon when he walks up to trade. The stun and knock up let you trade first.
Watch for Talon to disappear: when Shadow Assault is down he is much weaker, so push your lane and trade then.
Take Hijack on Talon when you can. Stealing his Shadow Assault gives you an invisibility escape or a burst of damage.
Use Chain Lash on Talon to slow him when he wants to roam. Keep an eye on the map after he leaves your lane.
Dodge Wild Cards early. Stay out of line with the fan and trade when he has used it.
Watch the card above his head. When the Gold Card is picked, move away so you are not stunned.
Hijack Destiny when it is ready and teleport onto him or a lane partner for a surprise attack.
Use Kingslayer when you are hurt in a trade, because it heals you more at low health.
Open with Abscond and recast it as Abduct to pull yourself onto Twisted Fate. This closes the gap fast and knocks him up.
When Destiny is used, expect a gank or a teleport and get safe.
Don't walk through the edge of Event Horizon. Stay inside it or step around it, because the stun comes from the edge.
Keep moving while Veigar casts Dark Matter. It lands after a delay, so step out of the marked circle.
Use Kingslayer to heal when you are hurt in a trade. It heals more the lower your health is.
Land Abduct on Veigar to reach him. He is fragile, so follow with Chain Lash and Kingslayer.
Stay out of Veigar's Primordial Burst range when you are low on health, since it hits harder the lower you are.
Don't dash in with Abscond or Abduct while Vex's Doom 'n Gloom is ready; her next ability can fear you and interrupt the dash.
Trade after Vex has spent her empowered ability, since she then has no fear to punish your dashes.
Use Kingslayer when you are low on health and she is in range; the heal is biggest when you are hurt.
Aim Chain Lash at where she will stand; the explosion comes after a delay and hits harder than the chains.
Hijack her Shadow Surge once it is available. It is a good way to reach her when she plays far back.
Hold Abduct until Viktor is close or has used Gravity Field. His Hextech Ray is easy to dodge with a dash.
Leave Gravity Field as soon as it lands. Staying inside gets you slowed, then stunned.
Use Kingslayer once you or Viktor is low on health, since it heals you more then. Viktor's shield from Siphon Power blunts early trades.
Hijack Viktor's Arcane Storm once it is up and he is committed. You get your own copy of his ultimate to use.
Pick fights when Vladimir has used Sanguine Pool; he can't be targeted while it lasts, so wait it out.
Hold Abscond / Abduct until Vladimir's Sanguine Pool is on cooldown; it dodges the pull.
Hit Vladimir with Chain Lash from range, because he heals by last-hitting with Transfusion.
Steal Hemoplague with Hijack and use it on Vladimir, since the burst also heals you.
Close the gap with Abscond, then use Abduct to pull yourself onto Xerath. Once you are on him, he has little room to fight back.
Stay out of a straight line with Xerath's Shocking Orb, and dash only after he has used it.
Use Kingslayer when you are hurt for a bigger heal. Xerath cannot easily escape once you are on him.
Hijack Xerath's Rite of the Arcane in a teamfight, and aim the missiles at his team.
Sidestep Arcanopulse and Eye of Destruction. Xerath's beam is thin and his blast lands after a delay, so keep moving.
Use Chain Lash and Abduct from range and keep Xin Zhao away. Once he is on you, his attacks and Audacious Charge hurt.
Hit Xin Zhao with Abduct when he finishes his third Three Talon Strike attack. The stun breaks his combo.
Stay spread from your team and respect his Crescent Guard. The knockback hits anyone not marked as Challenged.
Use Kingslayer when you are hurt and Xin Zhao is in reach. It heals you more the lower you are.
Take Xin Zhao's ultimate with Hijack when it is available. Fighting him while he cannot be hijacked is riskier.
Do not throw Abduct into a Yasuo who has Wind Wall ready; it blocks the chains and you will not dash to him.
Wait out Yasuo's Wind Wall, then use Chain Lash while it is on cooldown.
Do not knock Yasuo's allies up near him; Abduct gives Yasuo a Last Breath target. Be careful using it in team fights.
Chain a few spells together before you attack so Petricite Burst gives you extra hits, then trade while Yasuo is on cooldown.
Yasuo is weak just after his whirlwind; if he spends it, punish him with Kingslayer and your abilities.
Aim Abduct at Yone as he walks up to last-hit; it stuns and knocks him up, so you can follow with Kingslayer and a basic attack.
Use Chain Lash from long range when Yone steps up to the wave. It slows him, and the blast at the chains' crossing point punishes him if he stays put.
Wait until Yone is low, or until you are, before you use Kingslayer on him. The heal is strongest when you are hurt.
Hold Abduct while Yone is in spirit form. He can't be hit by the body he left behind, so wait for him to snap back and then trade.
Look to steal Fate Sealed with Hijack at level 6. You can then use it to knock up and pull enemies in a fight.
Aim Abduct at Zed when he commits. The chains stun him, and you get a knock up on arrival.
Chain Lash slows Zed and explodes after a delay. Cast it where he will step, such as his shadow's position.
Use Kingslayer to heal when you trade with Zed at low health. He is fragile, so the lunge also punishes him.
Zed is most exposed right after he uses Living Shadow. Hit him then, because his slow and damage depend on that shadow.
Hijack Death Mark at level 6 to turn Zed's ultimate on him. Use it only when you are sure it will land.
Dodge Sleepy Trouble Bubble, because being asleep makes you easy to burst. Stay out of her line when she is hiding behind walls.
Zoe is fragile, so land Abduct on her and burst her down. Aim it when she has used her bubble.
Hit Zoe with Chain Lash so she is slowed, then close in, since her Paddle Star! is weak up close.
Hit Zoe when she lands from Portal Jump, because she cannot move while she is there and must return to her starting point.
Steal Zoe's Portal Jump with Hijack when you can. It gives you an escape or a way to dive in.
